name: Shalzaru's Lair
summary: Hatecrest naga gather at Shalzaru's Lair on the Isle of Dread's northern tip. Their master directs them from flooded caverns south of Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: A Serpent Den in the Shallows
sections.body: At the Isle of Dread's northern end, the bluffs open into Shalzaru's Lair. A broad cavern and a smaller chamber join through submerged waterways. Hatecrest serpent guards patrol the dry paths, while sorceresses weave magic across the water. Deep within, Lord Shalzaru commands the Hatecrest brood across the island. The lair lies close to Sardor Isle, across the channel from the night elf Sentinels at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.answer: Shalzaru's Lair lies at the Isle of Dread's northern end, directly south of Sardor Isle and Feathermoon Stronghold off Feralas's western coast.
Shalzaru is a powerful naga warlord and master of the Hatecrest tribe on the Isle of Dread. He commands his forces from the lair's flooded caverns.

aliases: what enemies are in shalzaru lair
faq.answer: Hatecrest naga inhabit the cavern. Serpent guards watch the dry paths, and sorceresses weave magic across the underground waters.

faq.q: Why is this lair important to the local night elves?
aliases: why do night elves care about shalzaru
faq.answer: The Isle of Dread lies across the water from Feathermoon Stronghold. The naga gathered in Shalzaru's Lair threaten Shandris Feathermoon's forces and Sardor Isle's security.

angles.text: The Hatecrest gathering in this cavern threatens Feathermoon Stronghold's supply lines and peace. Clearing Shalzaru and his brood is a priority for the Sentinels and their allies.
As a night elf, you see naga defiling Feralas's ancient coastal ruins. Their presence recalls the Sundering and the Highborne's fall into monstrous corruption.
